full_judgment: 5. Being aggrieved by the judgment and order dated 03.12.2014, the Government preferred two separate Civil Petitions for Leave to Appeal, being Nos. 1024 and 1025 of 2015, before this Division. Upon hearing, leave was granted, giving rise to Civil Appeal Nos. 250 and 251 of 2015. The appeals were heard together and were dismissed by this Division by judgment and order dated 15.02.2017, thereby affirming the judgment of the High Court Division. Thereafter, the Government filed Civil Review Petitions Nos. 438 and 439 of 2017, which were dismissed as being barred by limitation by order dated 09.11.2017.
